arguments.text: Milestone complete: work.py implements layered configuration evaluation and report.json matches current requests.json/policy.json. Verified with py_compile, generated-report equality, and comprehensive assertions covering ordered layers, false/zero/empty preservation, null reset policy, unknown keys, strict types (bool excluded from integer), environment gating, exact lowercase booleans, ASCII signed-decimal integers, and invalid environment inputs. Remaining limit: malformed request/policy container behavior is unspecified; implementation assumes structurally valid inputs.
